blocks.text: National University-Nazareth School inched closer to a first-round sweep with a 25-15, 25-17, 25-18 victory over Ateneo de Manila University in the UAAP Season 89 girls' volleyball tournament, Thursday at the Paco Arena Events and Sports Center in Manila.
